enchantments.tooltip: Combat Mastery +4: +4 Enhancement bonus to the DC to resist the character's Trip, Improved Trip, Sunder, Improved Sunder, Stunning Blow, and Stunning Fist attempts.
Quality Combat Mastery +1: +1 Quality bonus to the DC to resist the character's Trip, Improved Trip, Sunder, Improved Sunder, Stunning Blow, and Stunning Fist attempts.
Seeker +5: Provides a +5 Enhancement bonus to confirm critical hits, and a +5 Enhancement bonus to critical hit damage (before multipliers are applied).
Speed +18%: +18% enhancement bonus to movement speed, 6% bonus to attack speed.
Temple's Tempest: 2 Pieces Equipped:+5 Artifact Bonus to Melee and Ranged Power+10 Artifact Bonus to Electric Spell Power+10 Artifact Bonus to Magical Resistance Rating
Mythic Trinket Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
